sources.name: Buller 2001
sources.scope: Personal complete original seven-page main, all 15 references/disclosures, extracted 27,692 characters from physical pages 23–29 of ICS workshop PDF. Entire extraction read [0:14500),[14500:27692). Actual figures 1–4 personally viewed on physical pages 26–28. Other 22 workshop pages not read; rendering of other paper pages is not visual-read credit.
sources.findings: Fifteen cadavers, 11 dissected hemipelves and four intact pressure experiments. Ischial spine is useful orientation but explicitly not a fixed measuring anchor. Variable distances, tissue planes and ureter pressure during traction prohibit universal 2-cm/1-cm safety rules. Cadaver strength is not clinical durability.

sources.name: Ramanah 2012
sources.scope: Personal complete 60,972-character main [0:21000),[21000:42000),[42000:end), all three tables, 56 references and disclosures. All six actual figures and every panel personally viewed at original detail. No associated supplement observed; underlying cited papers are not covered by this read.
sources.findings: USL is variable visceral support complex, not uniform bone-to-vagina cord. Deep ligament contains nerves and pelvic plexus relationships; spine is not a ruler. One narrative sentence reverses the rectal relationship compared with the rest of the text and figures; page uses rectum medial to USL.

sources.name: AUGS cystoscopy 2018
sources.scope: Personal complete two-page original, both columns, all 18 references. Initial whitespace-heavy output truncated, followed by complete compact-text read and visual read of both actual PDF pages. No graphic figures/tables. Official current directory separately checked: reaffirmed 2021.
sources.findings: Cystoscopy recommended for reconstructive prolapse procedures except isolated posterior repairs. Confirm bilateral efflux after repair. Normal findings do not rule out evolving or thermal injury; old dye-availability statements not carried forward.

sources.name: Cola 2022 ten-year

sources.findings: 287 analyzed of353eligible (66 lost). Fifty-five anatomic recurrences,18bulge,6reoperations. Complication denominator353 differs from long-term287.
